description: Source code implementing UDP datagram payload parsing, serialization, and handling for the quiche library, including classes ConnectUdpDatagramPayload, ConnectUdpDatagramUdpPacketPayload, and ConnectUdpDatagramUnknownPayload.

classes.name: ConnectUdpDatagramPayload
classes.description: Abstract base class for UDP datagram payloads with serialization and parsing functionalities.

classes.name: ConnectUdpDatagramUdpPacketPayload
classes.description: Represents a UDP packet payload with a fixed context ID and serialization logic.

classes.name: ConnectUdpDatagramUnknownPayload
classes.description: Handles unknown or unrecognized UDP payloads with serialization logic.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a datagram payload string into appropriate payload object based on context ID.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the payload object into a string.

methods.name: ConnectUdpDatagramUdpPacketPayload
methods.description: Constructor initializing with UDP packet data.

methods.name: GetContextId
methods.description: Returns the context ID of the payload.

methods.name: GetType
methods.description: Returns the type of the payload (UDP packet or unknown).

methods.name: GetUdpProxyingPayload
methods.description: Returns the UDP proxying payload data.

methods.name: SerializedLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of the serialized payload.

methods.name: SerializeTo
methods.description: Serializes the payload into a writer.

methods.name: ConnectUdpDatagramUnknownPayload
